description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Holy] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Angeal
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Succession (0~2), removed after using Succession two times

description.name: Succession Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Succession level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Angeal]

description.name: Succession Level
description.text: Keeps track of Succession level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Angeal]
